title: Textarea
summary: A multi-line control that can grow with its content up to a cap.

props.name: value
props.description: The current value; what the form submits.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: readonly
props.description: The value can be read but not edited.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted while the value is empty.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext).

props.name: warning
props.description: Shows the warning state (a value the user may want to check).

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible rows of a fixed-height textarea.

props.name: autogrow
props.description: Grows with the content instead of scrolling.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Auto-grow cap in pixels; 0 means no cap and the box scrolls beyond it otherwise.

events.name: input
events.description: The value changed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.value.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed the value (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-value-change
events.description: The user committed a new value (same moment as change; carries the value).

cssProperties.name: --pk-textarea-max-height
cssProperties.description: Cap on the auto-grow height (set from max-height).

a11y: A native textarea in the shadow root, named by label and described by description; invalid sets aria-invalid. Auto-grow never traps scrolling: a capped box scrolls internally.

examples.title: Fixed and auto-grow
examples.html:
<pk-textarea label="Notes" rows="3" value="Fixed height, resizable."></pk-textarea>
<pk-textarea label="Description" autogrow max-height="160" value="Grows as you type, up to 160px."></pk-textarea>
